method: Independent agent reviewed six preselected source-page associations. Strict view gates on the whole required response schema; this includes five valid-JSON shape mismatches and two empty final outputs. It is not fact recall. Correct requires source label/value, units and qualifiers in a fact or contextual table; contradictory claims are flagged. Page locators and other table quality are not scored.
sensitivity_method: Separate field-level review of five syntax-valid JSON objects that fail the full required schema, without repairing outputs or rerunning models. Nine further correct associations and one wrong association are found. Strict outcomes remain unchanged. Empty final-content responses remain unscorable. This does not establish production JSON compatibility.
